item.title: Criminal case dropped against former police officer in 2020 fatal shooting
item.description: An Alameda County judge on Friday agreed to dismiss a case against former San Leandro police officer Jason Fletcher, who was charged with voluntary manslaughter in the fatal shooting of Steven Taylor five years ago. The post Criminal case dropped against former police officer in 2020 fatal shooting appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Livermore Valley Arts reports ‘strong’ financial health following year of deficit-spending
item.description: Despite operating in the red last fiscal year, Livermore Valley Arts is doing well financially with an operating reserve of over $1.3 million, according to CEO Chris Carter and the nonprofit organization’s annual report to the City Council. The post Livermore Valley Arts reports ‘strong’ financial health following year of deficit-spending appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: LVJUSD, teachers union reach tentative agreement after marathon mediation day
item.description: Livermore school district and teachers union negotiators agreed to terms that would end their impasse late Friday night, with a deal centered around two salary increases during the 2026 calendar year and additional health and welfare benefits. The post LVJUSD, teachers union reach tentative agreement after marathon mediation day appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Planning Commission signals initial support for major redevelopment project off Dublin Canyon Road
item.description: The Pleasanton Planning Commission offered initial support last week for the Hidden Canyon Residences and Preserve Project, a major redevelopment proposal for an unincorporated area of Alameda County just south of Dublin Canyon Road. item.title: Superintendent Funk retiring from Dublin Unified at end of school year

item.title: Sports memorabilia dealer pleads guilty to fraud after selling fake Willie Mays items
item.description: A sports memorabilia dealer in Contra Costa County pleaded guilty Monday to wire fraud after he was caught selling fake sports collectibles, the U.S. Department of Justice said. item.title: Dublin among local police departments to receive funding to combat underage drinking
item.description: Six Bay Area police departments, including Dublin, have been selected to receive funding from the state Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control to help boost enforcement against underage drinking and alcohol-related harm within their communities.
